body_html:
JAMMIN’ DJs

Will be at the Sports Authority Field at Mile High Sunday January 29th from 12 noon to 4:00pm. We will be available for questions and to assist you with getting your event scheduled. JAMMIN’ DJs is Georgia’s Best DJ Service and has provided quality entertainment in the Denver Metro area for over 10years! Our DJ Service is second to none when you get the largest DJ service to provide you and your guests a night to remember. We have convenient package pricing and offer several promotional sales to help you in getting your event scheduled.

At the Sunday show we will be handing out FREE services and discounts so be sure to come out and take advantage of this once in a lifetime opportunity! We look forward to seeing you out there!
